text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After shopping with Satono Crown,
we decided to grab dinner before heading home—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was spending time in a restaurant
echoing with live violin music.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"A little bit.
...Have you heard of the 'Taylor Tournament'?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
It's an event to appraise the beauty and craft of suits.
Famous companies and artisans from around the world gather there.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Papa's company hosts it every year, and I've been helping out, but—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: I want to raise the prestige of the tournament this time. So that we can give a boost to the entire tailoring industry.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
So, to surpass the reception we get in normal years,
I've been brainstorming something extra special—
choice_data_list: ...How about starting with an eye-catching event?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Right from the start, huh...? If it's different from usual,
I should make that clear at the very beginning.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: We're holding a fashion show during the opening ceremony, and I want to add some kind of surprise—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap clap clap clap!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right then, the live violin performance ended,
and applause filled the shop.

Grazie!!
Please continue to enjoy your evening
alongside a wonderful dinner!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Oh! The musician from earlier was you, Earth?!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Hello, amore! The owner invited me!
Did you enjoy the ensemble of food and music
prepared exclusively for tonight?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It is a special experience
that can only be enjoyed here—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I see... The special feeling of actually being there...
Could that live atmosphere be the key...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
For example, let's see...
Instead of using recorded music for the fashion show, having a live performance, or...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Earth-san! Do you think it's possible to create an ensemble with live violin music and a fashion show?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Of course! It's quite difficult,
but all the more reason it will shine with brilliant light!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
The models' expressions, the lighting direction...
An once-in-a-lifetime ensemble weaving them all together!
It will undeniably captivate the hearts of everyone in the room!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
G-Great...!
Then what if—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Supposing you received such an offer...
would you want to accept it, Earth-san?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, I always welcome interesting ideas!
If there's a chance, I'd love to try it out!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Well then, please!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
We'd like you to play live music at the tailor competition's fashion show.
If it's difficult, Earth-san is the only one we can turn to!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: On top of that, her everyday sense of style, and her graceful, commanding presence!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"That's why there's no one more suited for this than you, Earth-san!
Please, I'm begging you!!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Fortississimo!!! What passionate fiamme!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"I have only one answer! Sì, certo!
I would gladly accept such a monumental duty!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you so much!
Thanks to you, this is going to be a wonderful opening ceremony!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"It'll definitely become the talk of... No, it absolutely will!
After all, I can clearly see my path to victory!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I'm delighted by your expectations.
I promise to perform the finest ensemble so that the light shining upon me never dims!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'll invite more members of the press
than usual!
I need to get started on the preparations right away!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"That's precisely why it'll be a show like no other.
I'll push every detail to the limit and pull it off!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
What intense passione...!
I swear that I shall answer your expectations!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, high motivation is the key to success, after all!
Shall we begin our meeting right away?
